			check_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = 33 }
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n33_project = 0 }
			RUS_ip_site_33_8 = yes
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = 34 }
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n34_project = 0 }
			RUS_ip_site_34_8 = yes
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = 35 }
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 0 }
			RUS_ip_site_35_8 = yes
		}
	}
